scripts.dev:server: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('app/dist',{recursive:true})" && wrangler dev -c server/wrangler.jsonc --var TOKEN_SECRET:nur-fuer-lokale-entwicklung --var SETUP_SECRET:lokal
scripts.check: tsc -p shared && tsc -p server && npm -w app run check
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c server/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:vorschau: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c server/wrangler.jsonc --env vorschau
